violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: OBSERVED IN-USE LADLES IN STANDING AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PROPER IN-USE UTENSIL METHODS WERE DISCUSSED WITH THE PIC. PIC REMOVED LADLES FROM STANDING WATER DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED NO PREPARED TCS FOODS MADE MORE THAN 24 HOURS PRIOR TO INSPECTION WERE DATE MARKED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL PREPARED/COOKED TCS FOODS KEPT FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS MUST HAVE A DATE MARKING. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE OF DEGREASER WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC ADDED LABEL TO SPRAY BOTTLE DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS CLEANING CONTAINERS SHOULD ALWAYS BE LABELED.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED COMMERCIALLY VACUUM PACKAGED TILAPIA IN LEFT 2-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER STILL INSIDE VACUUM PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: PIC UNDERSTANDS THAWING FISH IN VACUUM PACKAGING MUST BE REMOVED FROM PACKAGING OR THE PACKAGING SHOULD BE SLIT OPEN WHEN THAWING PROCESS BEGINS. PIC DISCARDED OF FISH DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED NO FOOD ITEMS PROPERLY LABELED IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL CONTAINER SHOULD BE LABELED. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS STORED DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN AND CANNED BEVERAGES STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE BACK HALLWAY.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL FOOD ITEMS MUST BE ELEVATED OFF THE FLOOR TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION AND TO ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION BY USING DUNNAGE RACKS AND SHELVING TO STORE ITEMS OFF THE GROUND.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean CATERING/SINGLE USE CONTAINERS were stored in DIRECTLY ON THE FLOOR IN SECTION OFF AREA ACROSS FROM SINGLE RESTROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS MUST BE STORED OFF THE FLOOR TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: GARLIC manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS (SPICES, SAUCES, ETC.) THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS ARE NOT DURABLE AND CANNOT BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED. PLEASE ENSURE FACILITY DISCONTINUES REUSE OF THESE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED LEFT TWO DOOR UNDER- COUNTER COOLER AT 57F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (41 WITHIN INTERNAL THERMOMETER), RIGHT 2-DOOR PREP TOP AT 50F, AND RIGHT 2-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER AT 53F WITH EHS THERMOMETER. OBSERVED BACK KITCHEN DISHWASHING MACHINE NOT DELIVERING SANITIZER AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL THESE UNITS MUST BE REPAIRED AND TCS FOODS MAY NOT BE STORED IN THESE UNTIL THEY CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP. PIC CONTACTED CONTRACTOR WHO REPAIRED DISHWASHING MACHINE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE DISHWASHING MACHINE CONTINUES TO DELIVER PROPER CONCENTRATION OF SANITIZER.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED INTERIOR OF ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS (BESIDES WALK-IN COOLER) SOILED TO SIGHT AND TOUCH WITH ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC UNDERSTANDS CLEANING FREQUENCY OF NON-FOOD CONTACT SURFACES MUST INCREASE. PLEASE ENSURE INTERIOR (GASKETS, SHELVING) AND EXTERIOR (HANDLES) MUST BE THOROUGHLY CLEANED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER STILL INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC INFORMED EHS PREVIOUS DUAL BLEED VALVE BROKE DURING INSTALLATION. PIC ORDERED ANOTHER DUAL BLEED VALVE DURING INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE IT IS INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED SMALL HOLES AND GAPS IN CEILING IN BACK KITCHEN AND SOME CEILING TILES MISSING ENTIRELY.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC WILL ENSURE HOLES ARE REPAIRED AND CEILING TILES ARE REPLACED BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION. Mirch Dhamaka (Inspection Date: 10/24/2024) Page 3 of 5

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC UNDERSTANDS CLEANING FREQUENCY OF FLOORS AND WALLS OF BACK KITCHEN MUST INCREASE TO PREVENT ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS/GRIME. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP.
